description: For people writing Agent Skills in their own repos: write a portable SKILL.md folder from a described task, then audit any skill for routing, portability, safety, structure and evals before you share it.

prerequisites: A task you repeat with your coding agent, and Python 3.9 or later for the lint script
first-value.starter-task: Turn a task you keep explaining into a skill, then review it
first-value.starter-prompt: Make a skill that writes customer-facing release notes from the merged PRs I paste: grouped New / Improved / Fixed, breaking changes first, one line per PR with its number. We use Claude Code and Copilot, and we already have a launch-post skill for announcements. Then review the skill before I commit it.
first-value.verification: skill-author writes a folder with SKILL.md, a template and evals, plus the install path for each of your tools, and skill-review returns a READY, FIX FIRST or REWRITE verdict with the lint script's output pasted in.
first-value.recovery: If a skill does not activate, ask for it by name ("use skill-author"). If the lint script will not run, check that python3 is on your PATH; skill-review can walk the same checks by hand.

journey.when: You keep explaining the same task to your coding agent, or you are about to share or install a skill and want to know it will route, work in every tool, and do nothing unsafe.
you_bring: the task: what it produces and what makes a good one
three to five things you'd type to ask for it
the skills already installed next to it, and which requests belong to them
the tools your team uses: Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Cursor, Kiro or Antigravity

steps.you_do: Describe the task, the trigger phrases and the nearby skills, and answer one round of questions.
steps.you_get: A skill folder: SKILL.md with a routable description, steps, quality bar, boundaries and anti-patterns, plus a template, evals, and the install path for each tool.

steps.you_do: Point it at the folder and at the folder that holds your other skills.
steps.you_get: The lint script's output and a verdict with severity-tagged findings on routing, portability, safety, structure and evals, each with a fix.
steps.decide: Commit the skill, apply the fixes and review again, or rewrite it around one artifact.

journey.you_end_with: A reviewed skill that installs into each of your tools from one folder, with evals to rerun when you change it.
